# IDKMesh

> Open-source verification-first coordination fabric for humans, AI agents, and heterogeneous compute working on uncertain goals.

Canonical site: https://mskazemi.com/idkmesh/
Canonical repository: https://github.com/MSKazemi/idkmesh
License: Apache-2.0
Status: research preview; not production software.

## Start

- [Home](https://mskazemi.com/idkmesh/) — what IDKMesh is, why verification is the bottleneck, and the shortest path into the project.
- [Start in 15 minutes](https://mskazemi.com/idkmesh/start.html) — install the CLI, run the bundled diagnostic, reproduce checks, and choose a bounded task.
- [How IDKMesh works](https://mskazemi.com/idkmesh/concepts.html) — bounded Work Units, authority boundaries, verification debt, correlated verifiers, and the evidence ladder.
- [Pipelines](https://mskazemi.com/idkmesh/pipelines.html) — work/evidence, orchestration, compute-admission, and PR-gate flows.
- [Documentation library](https://mskazemi.com/idkmesh/library.html) — published documentation by category.

## Reading rules

- The GitHub repository is the canonical source of truth for contracts, code, evidence, and decisions; this website is a discovery and presentation surface.
- Implemented mechanism, synthetic validation, observed evidence, and accepted conclusions are different evidence states and should not be collapsed.
- Worker success is not acceptance, verifier recommendation is not merge authority, and CI success is not independent human review.
- Claims about scale, safety, or effectiveness should be read at the evidence level stated by the linked source.
